question: During IUCD insertion, the inserter tube should be loaded inside the sterile packaging and no part of the device or inserter that will enter the uterine cavity should be touched with ungloved hands.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The no-touch technique requires that the IUCD is loaded in its sterile packaging without touching the device or inserter with bare hands. Breach of this principle is the most common cause of post-insertion PID.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. This is the 'no-touch' aseptic technique that is mandatory for IUCD insertion. Any contamination of the inserter or device dramatically increases the risk of post-insertion endometritis and PID.
